title: HPLT 3.0: Very Large-Scale Multilingual Resources for LLM and MT Mono- and Bi-lingual Data, Multilingual Evaluation, and Pre-Trained Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying dataset sizes, document lengths, and token counts across approximately 200 languages to evaluate and mitigate the English-centric disparity in existing large-scale pre-training corpora.
Analyzing internet domain distributions to quantify the over-representation of religious (biblical) texts in smaller, lower-resourced language datasets (e.g., African languages).
